actions: awarded $11.9 million in demolition and site revitalization grants
data.description: Ohio Governor Mike DeWine and Ohio Department of Development Director Lydia Mihalik announced $11.9 million in grants to help 73 counties demolish unsafe or blighted buildings and prepare sites for redevelopment.
data.name: Ohio Building Demolition and Site Revitalization grants — July 2026

sources.title: Governor DeWine Awards $11.9 Million to Support Demolition Projects in 73 Counties
DeWine supports demolition projects across Ohio

summary: On July 17, 2026, the Ohio Department of Development announced $11.9 million in Building Demolition and Site Revitalization Program grants covering 73 counties; Spectrum News independently reported the same statewide award and program purpose.
title: Ohio awards $11.9 million for demolition and site revitalization projects
